trajectory_metrics.scientific_rationale: Trajectory ATE/RPE requires a calibrated external mocap or survey-grade LiDAR trajectory ground truth rig, which is not present in this dataset. We report exact landmark lifecycle precision, recall, and false invalidation rates rather than unverified synthetic error estimates.
